newsitem.title: KAZAKHSTAN: Kazakh man sets himself ablaze over lost job.
newsitem.headline: Kazakh man sets himself ablaze over lost job.

text.p: A man died after he doused himself with petrol and set himself ablaze after losing his job at a recently privatised heating station in Kazakhstan, the Karavan Blitz newspaper said on Thursday.

The man set himself alight in front of the plant, which provides hot water to the Kazakh capital Almaty, early on Wednesday. He lost his job as a driver five days earlier, the daily reported. He died later in hospital.
The transition to a market economy in the oil-rich former Soviet republic is hurting millions of people as enterprises fail. Wages often go unpaid for months.
